_prune_cache() {
  local dir="$1"
  local budget_kb="$2"
  [[ -d "$dir" ]] || return 0

  # Calculate initial size
  local total
  total=$(du -sk -- "$dir" | cut -f1)

  # List files from oldest to newest, prune until budget is met
  while [[ -n "$(ls -A "$dir")" ]] && (( total > budget_kb )); do
    # Get the oldest file (first in listing from -t)
    local oldest
    oldest=$(ls -t -- "$dir" | head -n 1)

    # Calculate its size
    local sz
    sz=$(du -sk -- "$dir/$oldest" | cut -f1)

    # Remove the file
    rm -rf -- "$dir/$oldest"

    # Recalculate total directory size
    total=$(du -sk -- "$dir" | cut -f1)
  done
}

_prune_cache() {
  local dir="$1"
  local budget_kb=$2
  [[ -d "$dir" ]] || return 0

  # Function to get modification time of a file
  local get_mtime() {
    stat -f "%m" "$1" 2>/dev/null || stat "%Y" "$1" 2>/dev/null
  }

  # Function to get file size in KB
  local get_size() {
    du -sk "$1" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1
  }

  local total_size
  while true; do
    local oldest_file=""
    local oldest_mtime=""
    local candidate
    for candidate in "$dir"/*; do
      [[ -f "$candidate" ]] || continue
      local mtime
      mtime=$(get_mtime "$candidate")
      if [[ -z "$oldest_mtime" ]] || [[ "$mtime" -lt "$oldest_mtime" ]]; then
        oldest_mtime="$mtime"
        oldest_file="$candidate"
      fi
    done

    [[ -z "$oldest_file" ]] && break

    local sz
    sz=$(get_size "$oldest_file")
    [[ "$sz" -eq 0 ]] && continue

    rm -f "$oldest_file"
    total=$(( total - sz ))
    (( total <= budget_kb )) && break
  done
}
